patch_description: Combines the current model’s independent per-qubit RY expressivity and parallel sparse connectivity with the phase-oriented RZ/CZ structure of the crossover parent. Each wire retains its own phase degree of freedom, avoiding the underfitting caused by fully collective rotations. The same RZ parameter is reused before and after the commuting CZ layer, preserving the effective phase family of independent pre/post rotations while reducing the block from 24 to 16 unique parameters. The line-CZ gates are edge-colored into two parallel groups, lowering circuit depth without changing their unitary product. The resulting circuit has 98 total parameters and retains strong gradient scaling through repeated phase use.
